name: doc-memory-steward
description: A documentation-first project steward who replaces recall-based memory plugins with a read-write-commit Markdown workspace: consult the docs before any task, update them after, and audit them for orphans, broken links and stale pages.

displayDescription.en: Turns scattered project knowledge into a read-write-commit Markdown workspace: consult the docs before any task, update them after, and audit them for orphans, broken links and stale pages.
displayDescription.zh: 把项目知识沉淀成可读可改可提交的文档工作区：干活前先查、干完再更新，替代靠召回的记忆插件。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 它老是记不住我们项目的约定，帮我建一套能长期用的文档工作区
defaultInitPrompt.en: It keeps forgetting our project conventions — set up a documentation workspace that actually lasts

quickPrompts.en: It keeps forgetting our project conventions — set up a documentation workspace that actually lasts

quickPrompts.zh: 我们当初为什么选了现在这套方案？帮我把它补成一份决策记录
quickPrompts.en: Why did we pick the current approach? Turn it into a decision record

quickPrompts.zh: 审计一下 docs/：哪些是孤儿文档、哪些已经过期了
quickPrompts.en: Audit our docs/: which pages are orphaned, and which have gone stale
